messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in Kannada, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 90 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in Kannada>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

content: {"text": "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಕಾಯಿ ಅವರೆ, ಕಳೆದ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026 ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ UPI ಮೊತ್ತ ₹92,145 ಆಗಿದ್ದು, ₹1 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವುದು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿತ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಿಂಗಳ UPI ₹1 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದ್ದರೆ, ₹2,000 ಮೇಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಪಾವತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ₹236 ಶುಲ್ಕ ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಿಂಗಳ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ₹13,500 ನಗದು ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪಾವತಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೀವು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಾಗ ಅವು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಲದ ಅರ್ಜಿಯನ್ನು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಸಾಲದಾತರು ಈ ದಾಖಲಿತ ಮಾರಾಟಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. \nMerchant support team", "english": "Hello Kai, In October 2026, your UPI total was ₹92,145, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies under the proposed framework. However, if your monthly UPI was above ₹1 lakh, a fee of ₹236 would apply only to payments above ₹2,000. At month-end, ₹13,500 was taken in cash. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. \nMerchant support team"}
